claim_en: THREE OLIVES. Nine flows totally ordered; the first for the menorah; beaten required for the light only.
THE WESTERN LAMP. Begin and end at it; relit from the outer altar; nearer the veil; one priest; evening-to-morning exclusive.
THE TWELVE LOAVES. Wheat bought; equal; one by one; two at a time; three molds; two rows of six by three constraints.
THE PROPS AND FRANKINCENSE. Four props, twenty-eight reeds; both rows; the frankincense as indispensable permitter in two dishes; two handfuls.
THE SABBATH EXCHANGE. New in, old burned; reeds off on Friday; everything lengthwise but the ark; three and two.
THE EATING. Holy place for eating, kneading, shaping; one broken all void; Aaron without division; after the fire's gift.
